messages:
Luisa Moreno: quick favor — can someone run a lightweight onboarding sweep for sable-13b on g5.2x (q4_0, kvcache enabled)? want p50/p95/p99 for ctx=16,64,1024 and batch sizes 1/4/8. check warmup (first 10 requests) + 30m steady to look for mem leaks. no need for huge tokens, 128 gen is fine. tag results here when done. thanks :pray:

BenchBot: queued bench job sable-13b-2311112222-01. runner: perf-cage-7. ETA ~15m. will post artifacts to s3 when finished.

Rachel Kim: ran smoke + 30m steady window, posting quick summary below. let me know if you want full traces.

Rachel Kim: ```
Model: sable-13b
HW: g5.2xlarge (4xA10G equivalent)
Quant: q4_0
KV cache: on
Gen len: 128 tokens
Batches: 1 / 4 / 8
Contexts: 16 / 64 / 1024

Summary (latency in ms, single-request generation)
- ctx=16, batch=1: p50=48, p95=115, p99=230
- ctx=16, batch=4: p50=62, p95=140, p99=280
- ctx=16, batch=8: p50=84, p95=185, p99=360

- ctx=64, batch=1: p50=120, p95=260, p99=420
- ctx=64, batch=4: p50=160, p95=340, p99=560
- ctx=64, batch=8: p50=210, p95=430, p99=760

- ctx=1024, batch=1: p50=420, p95=980, p99=1400
- ctx=1024, batch=4: p50=520, p95=1200, p99=1750
- ctx=1024, batch=8: p50=760, p95=1700, p99=2400

Warmup: tail (p99) drops ~15-20% after 3 warmup requests for short ctx. Long ctx warmup negligible after 2 requests.
Memory: process RSS peaked ~13.1GB, stable during 30m window. no growth trend observed.
Errors: none in 30m run. throughput behaved linearly with batch size until GPU memory bound at batch=8 for ctx=1024.
```

Evan Li: nice, thanks. did you run with streaming on/off? curious about impact on tail for short ctx.

Rachel Kim: ran both. streaming=true shaved ~30-40ms at p99 for ctx=16/batch=1. I included per-request timing in artifacts. streaming didn't change long-ctx p99 much.

Luisa Moreno: good to know. what about kvcache warm vs cold? did you test cold starts?

Rachel Kim: yes — cold (no kv cached) p99 for ctx=1024 was ~1600ms initially then converged to 1400ms after one full pass. so cold penalty exists but is only ~12-15% for long ctx.

BenchBot: artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/sable-13b/2311112222/ (bench.log, perf-summary.csv, traces/, flamegraph.svg)

Tess O'Connor: looks promising. can we recommend q4_0 + batch=4 for hosted canary? sounds like best cost/latency tradeoff for mid-size prompts. also request adding a note about batch limits for ctx>512.

Luisa Moreno: agree — propose canary (10% traffic) with quant=q4_0, default batch=4, streaming=true, fallback to s7-small if latency spike > 2x. Evan, can you review rollout policy?

Evan Li: will do. quick ask: can Rachel attach the exact bench command and env (docker image + runtime flags) so we can reproduce on dedicated?

Rachel Kim: pasted the run command below:

Rachel Kim: ```bash
# run on perf-cage-7
docker run --gpus all -e MODEL=sable-13b -e QUANT=q4_0 
  -e KV_CACHE=1 -e STREAMING=1 redwood/bench:2026-02-10 
  /opt/bench/run_sweep.sh --batches 1,4,8 --contexts 16,64,1024 --gen_len 128 --out /artifacts/sable-13b-2311112222

# quick mem check during run
ps aux | grep bench_worker && tail -n 200 /var/log/bench/bench.log | grep -E "RSS|OOM|error"
```

Luisa Moreno: perfect. action items: Rachel will add perf-summary.csv to internal model-catalog entry, Evan will draft canary rollout policy, Tess will note catalog recommendation. Rachel, can you also run an additional 2-hour soak overnight and post any regressions tomorrow?

Rachel Kim: yep will kick off soak tonight and post results in the morning.

BenchBot: soak started: job sable-13b-soak-2311112222-02. ETA 2h. will append to same s3 path when done.

Luisa Moreno: thanks all — closing thread for now, will reopen if soak shows anything. ✅
